channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Tony Robbins — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “Where focus goes, energy flows.” — Tony Robbins

item.title: Thich Nhat Hanh — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “Drink your tea slowly and reverently, as if it is the axis on which the world earth revolves.” — Thich Nhat Hanh

item.title: Charlotte Bronte — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “I am not an angel, and I will not be one till I die: I will be myself.” — Charlotte Bronte

item.title: Mother Teresa — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “The fruit of silence is prayer; the fruit of prayer is faith; the fruit of faith is love; the fruit of love is service; the fruit of service is peace.” — Mother Teresa

item.title: Victor Hugo — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “In proportion as I advance in life, I grow more simple, and I become more and more patriotic for humanity.” — Victor Hugo

item.title: Anton Chekhov — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “Love, friendship, respect do not unite people as much as common hatred for something.” — Anton Chekhov

item.title: J.K. Rowling — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “We must all face the choice between what is right and what is easy.” — J.K. Rowling

item.title: Al-Ghazali — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “Knowledge without action is wastefulness and action without knowledge is foolishness.” — Al-Ghazali
